cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: her private chamber in a Han-era residence — holds a book closed against her chest; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; A compact planetarium lobby beside a bench made of dark glass and a miniature orbital map — She pauses on her way to the morning show and opens a little ticket envelope to check her seat; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A public ferry pavilion with pale stone benches and a clear view of the harbour at golden hour — She pauses to watch projected sea charts before departure; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a quiet spa lounge of robes — works a hairbrush through a tangled lock of hair; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — lying on her front; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — seated on a chair; the rail of a harbour ferry deck in the wind — standing
